subject: general
question: In which year did India launch an imaging satellite called the Technology Experiment Satellite (TES)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Technology Experiment Satellite (TES)**, weighing 1108 kg, was launched on **October 22, 2001**.
 
• Technology Experiment Satellite is an **Indian remote sensing and photo-reconnaissance satellite.**
 
• **The Aryabhata spacecraft,** named after the famous Indian astronomer, was** India's first satellite.**
 
• TES is an **experimental satellite to demonstrate **and validate the technologies like attitude and orbit control systems and high-torque reaction wheels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f88e130c44d1d8fcfe3b1739057e3689859b3a25ee4ac802c189904c42de69.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Aryabhata was the first **unmanned Earth satellite** built by India.
 
• **ISRO's Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle, PSLV-C24, **fortunately, started **IRNSS-1B**, the second satellite in the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS)​.
 
• India has established **346 satellites** for 36 different countries as of** 30 June 2022.**
